ammunition.description: Rocket of the vanilla Zamak MRL (ACE realistic name: KamAZ MRL). Designation requires verification.

default.notes: dElevPer100m and dTofPer100m are the in-game 'D ELEV PER 100 M DR' and 'TIME OF FLIGHT PER 100 M DR' columns: change per 100 m of height difference. The remaining columns are the in-game weather corrections (ACE3 advanced corrections): azimuth correction in mil per 1 m/s of crosswind and range corrections in metres per 1 m/s of head/tail wind, per 1 °C of air temperature below/above 15 °C and per 1 % of air density below/above standard. Range corrections are added to the range used for the table lookup. A null value means the game table shows '-'. Transcribed from in-game screenshots, see web/data-sources. LOW mode: the D ELEV and TIME OF FLIGHT PER 100 M DR columns are negative (a higher target needs more elevation); some ranges are skipped by the game. The game shows no alternative table with air resistance for this launcher. HIGH charges 0-15 are identical to Seara row by row; LOW tables were re-taken on 26.10.2026 and match H-12 LOW 0-7.
